notes:
Viação Primor (Grupo Primor TCM) is a São Luís, MA municipal BUS operator (SIT São Luís system, Lote 2 emergencial + new lines). São Luís has NO metro/light-rail/BRT/suburban-rail, so all routes are route_type=3 (bus). Timezone America/Fortaleza (Maranhão, UTC-3, no DST).

ROUTES (6) evidenced by Moovit/SETSL/Jornal Pequeno as operated by or newly assigned to Viação Primor: T501 ANGELIM/TERMINAL PRAIA GRANDE, T035 RIBEIRA/IPASE VIA TERMINAIS, T051 TERM.COHAMA/SÃO CRISTÓVÃO/HOLANDESES, T054 VICENTE FIALHO, T506 VINHAIS/SÃO FRANCISCO, T955 CIDADE VERDE/SÃO FRANCISCO VIA TERMINAIS. Lines A696 and C087 are mentioned as newly assigned but NO route name/terminals/itinerary were found, so they were omitted rather than invented.

SCHEDULE: T501 uses REAL published departure times (weekday 40 trips 05:40-21:00; Sat 29 trips; Sun 12 trips) from horariodeonibus.net + Moovit, alternating directions. The other 5 lines had route names/terminals but no published per-trip timetable found, so even headways across evidenced service windows were generated (weekday 30min, Sat 40min, Sun 60min).

STOPS: 17 anchors — the evidenced integration terminals (Cohama/Vinhais, Praia Grande, São Cristóvão, Cohab/Cohatrac) and neighborhood/landmark anchors (Angelim, Shopping da Ilha, Ipase, Deodoro, Monte Castelo, Beira-Mar, São Francisco, Vinhais, Vicente Fialho, Cidade Verde, Ribeira, Holandeses, Bequimão) that appear in the Moovit/CittaMobi itineraries. Coordinates are WGS-84 from web geocoding: Terminal Cohama/Vinhais (-2.51967,-44.24694) and Shopping da Ilha (-2.53409,-44.26061) and Angelim (-2.51512,-44.23661) are precise; Praia Grande (~-2.529,-44.306) is approximate; the remaining neighborhood anchors are approximate bairro centroids (±0.5-1km). The real routes have 60-78 micro-stops each — these are NOT modeled; each trip is represented by its ordered evidenced terminal/neighborhood anchors, with a 5-minute inter-anchor segment estimate (times are ordering-correct but intermediate anchor clock times are interpolated, not published).

CONFIDENCE 0.45: route list + T501 timetable + terminal coordinates are well-grounded; but full per-stop sequences/coordinates and the other 5 lines' exact timetables are approximated. Feed is structurally valid GTFS (referential integrity + monotonic times verified). Full CSVs written to /home/ubuntu/adresses/gtfs_primor/ (agency, stops, routes, trips=481, stop_times=2248, calendar). Structured output below carries all stops/routes/calendar and one representative trip per route/direction/service (36 trips, 168 stop_times).

Sources: moovitapp.com (SMTT lines São Luís), linhas.cittamobi.com.br (T501), horariodeonibus.net (T501 times), setsl.com.br/consorcios, jornalpequeno.com.br (Lote 2 assignment), IBGE/geocoding for coordinates.
